Scan code files for artificial limit patterns

Source: R/sanity_checks.R
mysterycall_scan_for_limits.Rd

Scans R source files for common limiting anti-patterns that violate the package policy of processing all available data. This is a code audit tool to catch unintentional data limiting.

Usage

mysterycall_scan_for_limits(
  path = "R",
  recursive = TRUE,
  exclude_pattern = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Directory to scan. Defaults to "R/" directory.

recursive

Whether to scan subdirectories. Defaults to TRUE.

exclude_pattern

Optional regex pattern of files to exclude from scan. For example, "test-.*\\.R$" to exclude test files.

Value

A data frame with one row per detected issue and columns:

file

Character. Basename of the scanned R file.

line

Integer. Line number where the pattern was found.

severity

Character. One of "CRITICAL", "HIGH", or "MEDIUM".

pattern

Character. Human-readable description of the anti-pattern detected.

code

Character. Trimmed source code line that triggered the match.

Returns a zero-row data frame with these columns when no issues are found. Rows are sorted by severity (CRITICAL first), then file, then line number. Also emits base::message() for each detected issue.

Details

Searches for these anti-patterns:

  • slice_head(n = )

  • head(data, n)

  • sample_n()

  • n_max =

  • max_records =

  • LIMIT n (SQL)

See also

mysterycall_check_no_limits() to validate row counts at runtime; mysterycall_check_no_data_loss(), mysterycall_check_api_response().

Other utilities: .title_case(), %>%(), format_phone_number(), mysterycall_assess_data_quality(), mysterycall_check_api_response(), mysterycall_check_data_completeness(), mysterycall_check_dependencies(), mysterycall_check_no_data_loss(), mysterycall_check_no_limits(), mysterycall_download_file(), mysterycall_estimate_resources(), mysterycall_export_with_backup(), mysterycall_normalize_file_format(), mysterycall_parse_redcap_labels(), mysterycall_preflight_check(), mysterycall_quality_tier(), mysterycall_read_table(), mysterycall_require_arrow(), mysterycall_resolve_path(), mysterycall_save_quality_table(), mysterycall_standard_labels(), mysterycall_standard_palette(), mysterycall_write_table()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Scan all R files in package
issues <- mysterycall_scan_for_limits("R/")

# Scan with exclusions
issues <- mysterycall_scan_for_limits("R/", exclude_pattern = "deprecated")
}
